name: Hornero Calendar
description: Calendar: desktop widget with date/time header and current month grid from PluginKit Time, plus Desktop Widgets 2.0 size classes, per-display slot display and hide-with-restore. Locale dates, no events backend, no processes or network.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Desktop Widgets 2.0 (#32): manifest v2 with the desktop surface redeclared on the same entrypoint, read-only Desktop.position slot and display shown in a host-owned popover, persisted compact/standard/wide size class (month-grid cells follow it) and hide-with-restore visibility as typed settings (defaults standard/visible, so 2.0 content is unchanged), and reset for size and visibility. Moving stays in Control Center: PluginKit has no slot setter.

Time and Agenda 2.0: current-month grid with today marked under the unchanged 1.x time/date header, locale-correct month and weekday names, typed clock-format/week-start settings with 1.x defaults, shared Time facade and Argentine Spanish catalog. No events are shown: PluginKit has no calendar data source.
Desktop widget showing the current time and full date from the PluginKit Time service.

twentyFourHour.description: Use a 24-hour large clock (the 1.x HH:mm behaviour); off shows 12-hour AM/PM.

showShellTime.description: Show the shell-formatted time line under the date (the 1.x third line).

showMonthGrid.description: Show the current month grid with today marked.

weekStart.description: First weekday column of the month grid. PluginKit does not expose the locale week start.

sizeClass.description: Desktop widget size class within the host width cap (300 logical px today); standard keeps the 2.0 size. This sizes content, not the slot.

showOnDesktop.description: Show the widget content on the desktop (the 2.0 behaviour). Off leaves a visible Show widget button so the content can always be restored.
